title: Cross-work Sunset Orchestration and Centralized Release Notes Hub
creator: Ana Morales
description: Create a coordinated, repeatable playbook and a centralized release-notes hub to run phased deprecations for model and API variants. This ticket scopes cross-team launch planning (PM/Eng/Design/Support/Docs/Sales), templated communications, gated rollout windows, rollback criteria, and a single source-of-truth release-notes artifact that can be surfaced in Console, email, and partner-facing docs. Goal: reduce customer confusion during sunsets, shorten migration cycles, and provide clear canary/rollback signals for infra teams.
acceptance_criteria: A living release-notes hub exists in Confluence and is linked to the Console release banner and in-product upgrade prompts
Cross-team launch checklist completed and approved by Eng, Design, Support, and Legal for the first pilot sunset
Automated changelog extraction PR (docs <-> GitHub) merged and the 'upgrade path' section generated for the pilot model variant
Rollback and fallback playbooks documented with SLO thresholds and clear pager escalation paths
Customer comms cadence template (initial notice, reminder, final notice, post-sunset summary) created and approved for regionalization
tasks: Draft master playbook outline and publish to Confluence
Build release-notes hub template and field mappings (version, breaking changes, migration steps, SDK compatibility)
Integrate release-notes hub with marketing email templates and Console banner API
Create in-product migration checklist (quick links to code samples, SDK snippet, compatibility matrix)
Schedule cross-team dry run for pilot sunset and record session for postmortem
comments: 2026-02-22 - Ana: Initial kickoff completed with Eng (runtime), Docs, Design, Support. Agreed pilot target: deprecate legacy quantized variant q4-legacy by Apr 1. Action: Eng to provide exact deprecation signal hooks (headers + telemetry) by 2026-03-01.

2026-03-04 - Support (Tess): Prepared FAQ draft for customers; requested clear SDK migration snippets for Python/Node. Added support cross-link to support runbook: https://confluence.redwood.dev/support/sunset-runbooks/PM-523411

review_feedback: Design: Keep banner copy concise; use 'Prepare your integration' instead of 'Migrate ASAP' to reduce alarm
Security: Confirm no secret telemetry will be exposed by deprecation hooks; security review not required for metadata-only metrics
Support: Provide three canonical migration examples (Python sync, Node streaming, cURL) with expected token delta estimates
Engineering: Prefer feature-flagged rollout for first 10% of customers, then 50% before full cutover; require automatic fallback to compatible variant on elevated 5xx rates
rollout_plan_phases: Phase 0 - Internal dry run: cross-team rehearsal, ensure telemetry is firing (target date 2026-03-18)
Phase 1 - Canary (10%): Release banner + targeted email to early adopters; monitor error rates and migration click-through (2 business days)
Phase 2 - Ramp (50%): If canary stable, widen to self-serve customers; targeted CS outreach for high-usage accounts (5 business days)
Phase 3 - Public notice (100%): Publish final deprecation notice and disable legacy variant after final notice window
Phase 4 - Post-sunset review: Postmortem and metrics digest (customer fallback rate, support volume, migration rate)
